property_sets.name: Reviera_GlazingUnit
property_sets.description: A glazing build-up's light, thermal and safety values (spec ARC-GLZ-003), on glazing types: sloped glazing roof types and curtain wall types. Typical values come from Reviera's glazing library and are replaced by the specified product's.

properties.name: VisibleTransmittance
properties.description: Share of visible light the glazing lets through at normal incidence.

properties.name: ParTransmittance
properties.description: Share of photosynthetically active radiation (400–700 nm) let through, for crop-light analysis.

properties.name: Haze
properties.description: Share of the transmitted light that is diffused (horticultural diffuse glass, multiwall sheet).

properties.name: Interlayer
properties.description: A laminate's interlayer thickness (0.38 mm, 0.76 mm …).

properties.name: MassPerArea
properties.description: Weight per area of glazing (stored with the per-length measure, as IFC has no per-area mass measure).

properties.name: MinimumPitch
properties.description: The least roof pitch the glazing is laid at.

properties.name: Structure
properties.description: Multiwall sheet's or film's structure: twin-wall, five-wall, multi-skin, single film, double inflated film.
